user_message: Explain why a rainbow appears at a preferred angle, and state where the common prism analogy breaks down.
allowed_evidence: In a spherical raindrop, sunlight refracts on entry, reflects internally, and refracts again on exit. Near the primary-rainbow angle, a range of incoming rays bunches into a narrow range of outgoing directions.
public_rubric: Traces the ray mechanism through the drop.
Explains angular concentration rather than only listing refraction and reflection.
Mentions wavelength dependence or another relevant limitation.
